title: Slices of weakly convergent represented currents converge weakly at levels not charged by the limit measures (parent step 5 via (T2))
statement: Assume (T2), the (T2) part of the conjunct (T1) ∧ (T2) ∧ (MM) of the selected node's dependency foundations (dtc_bc_tc_cl_foundations; verbatim, and also the type of the accepted declaration cbr_sublevel_restriction_tendsto): for P, k ∈ ℕ, open U ⊆ ℝ^P, Y_j ⇀ Y in 𝒟_k(U) with admissible representations (μ_j, ξ_j) of Y_j and (μ_Y, ξ_Y) of Y (measures finite on compact subsets of U, a.e. strongly measurable fields with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e., representing on all test forms of U), a measure ν finite on compact subsets of U with limsup_j μ_j(K) ≤ ν(K) for compact K ⊆ U, continuous f and t ∈ ℝ with ν{f = t} = 0: ∫_{f<t}ξ_j(ω)dμ_j → ∫_{f<t}ξ_Y(ω)dμ_Y for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Let P, d ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, f : ℝ^P → ℝ continuous, t ∈ ℝ, and X_j ⇀ X in 𝒟_{d+1}(U). Let (μ_j, ξ_j) and (μ'_j, ξ'_j) be admissible representations in U of X_j and ∂X_j, and (μ, ξ), (μ', ξ') admissible representations in U of X and ∂X. Let ν, ν' be measures finite on compact subsets of U with limsup_j μ_j(K) ≤ ν(K) and limsup_j μ'_j(K) ≤ ν'(K) for compact K ⊆ U, and ν{f = t} = ν'{f = t} = 0. Let A_j, A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) and B_j, B ∈ 𝒟_d(U) satisfy A_j(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ_j(ω)dμ_j, B_j(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'_j(η)dμ'_j, A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms. Then ∂A_j − B_j ⇀ ∂A − B in 𝒟_d(U).
